# Farn

> Token-first CSS design system for the web. Palette tokens, semantic tokens, and opt-in component classes. Zero framework assumptions — opt-in JavaScript available for nav and tab components.

## Install

```
npm install farn-theme
```

Then import in your bundler (Vite, webpack, Parcel, etc.):

```css
@import "farn-theme";            /* full bundle: tokens + base reset */
@import "farn-theme/tokens";     /* tokens only — no reset */
@import "farn-theme/components"; /* opt-in: nav, footer, buttons, cards, forms, badges, accordion… */
@import "farn-theme/typography"; /* opt-in: .text-h1, .text-body, .text-mono… */
@import "farn-theme/layout";     /* opt-in: .container, .stack, .cluster, .center, .auto-grid, .sidebar, .grid-2, .grid-3 */
```

Or link from CDN (replace `@0.3.0` with the latest tag):

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jabopiti/farn-theme@0.3.0/dist/farn.css">
```

### Optional JavaScript

Two opt-in scripts ship alongside the CSS:

```js
import 'farn-theme/scripts/nav';  /* nav: theme toggle, mobile drawer, scroll fill/autohide */
import 'farn-theme/scripts/tabs'; /* tab component progressive enhancement */
```

`nav.js` is required for `.nav-theme-toggle`, mobile drawer open/close, and the
`data-nav-fill` / `data-nav-autohide` scroll behaviors. The `.nav` CSS classes render
correctly without it — the nav appears filled and the drawer is hidden.

## Core rules

- **Token hierarchy**: always reference semantic tokens (`--color-*`, `--space-*`, `--text-*`, `--font-*`, `--radius-*`). Never use raw palette tokens (`--in*`, `--bm*`, `--fo*`, `--bl*`) in component or page styles.
- **Fraunces headings**: every Fraunces usage must include `font-variation-settings: 'opsz' <value>` — the font renders incorrectly without it. Use `72` for display/`h1`, `24` for `h2`, `20` for `h3` and pullquotes.
- **Dark / light mode**: set `data-theme="dark"` or `data-theme="light"` on `<html>`. Toggle via JavaScript and persist to `localStorage` under the key `farn-theme`.
- **Surface depth**: use `data-surface="base|layer|overlay|featured"` on any element to set depth context. All children inherit re-scoped tokens automatically — `base` is page-level, `layer` is cards/panels, `overlay` is modals/dropdowns, `featured` is always dark regardless of page theme (use for hero/brand sections).
- **Combine theme + surface**: `<section data-theme="dark" data-surface="layer">` renders a dark panel regardless of the page theme. `featured` is self-contained — do not also set `data-theme="dark"` on the same element.
- **FOWT prevention**: add an inline `<script>` in `<head>` before any CSS that reads `localStorage.getItem('farn-theme')` and sets `data-theme` on `<html>` before first paint.
- **Load order**: `farn.css` (or `farn-tokens.css`) first, then `farn-components.css`, then `farn-typography.css` and/or `farn-layout.css`. Both `farn-typography.css` and `farn-layout.css` depend on tokens from `farn.css` / `farn-tokens.css` and are not standalone.

## Layout primitives (`farn-layout.css`)

Opt-in composition layer. Load after `farn.css` or `farn-tokens.css`.

| Class | Description | Override points |
|---|---|---|
| `.container` | Max-width (`--width-content`) centered wrapper. Sets `container-type: inline-size` so `@container` queries fire on children. Responsive padding (`--space-lg` → `--space-md` at `<640px`). | — |
| `.container-narrow` | Same as `.container` with `--width-narrow` (640px). | — |
| `.container-prose` | Same as `.container` with `--width-prose` (70ch). | — |
| `.stack` | Vertical flex column. | `--stack-gap` (default `--gap-md`) |
| `.cluster` | Horizontal flex wrap row. | `--cluster-gap` (default `--gap-md`) |
| `.center` | Flex centering both axes. | — |
| `.auto-grid` | `auto-fit` grid — columns fill available space. Inherently responsive. See also `.card-grid` in `farn-components.css` (fixed 280px min). | `--grid-min` (default 280px), `--grid-gap` |
| `.sidebar` | Two-column grid: fixed sidebar + flexible main. Collapses to 1 col at `<600px` in container context. | `--sidebar-w` (default 300px), `--grid-gap` |
| `.grid-2` | Two equal columns. Collapses at `<500px`. | `--grid-gap` |
| `.grid-3` | Three equal columns. Collapses to 2 cols at `<900px`, 1 col at `<500px`. | `--grid-gap` |

**Gap tokens** (in `farn-tokens.css`, aliases for `--space-*`): `--gap-xs` (6px), `--gap-sm` (12px), `--gap-md` (24px), `--gap-lg` (36px), `--gap-xl` (48px).

**Responsive collapsing** requires a container context — place grids inside `.container` or any element with `container-type: inline-size`. `.auto-grid` is self-responsive via `auto-fit` and does not need a container context.

Override gaps inline: `<div class="stack" style="--stack-gap: var(--gap-sm)">`.

## Token layers

Farn uses a three-tier token architecture:

1. **Palette** — raw color values; never reference directly. Prefixed `--in*` (Iron Night dark), `--bm*` (Birch Mist light), `--fo*` (Forest accent), `--bl*` (Bloom palette).
2. **Semantic** — purpose-mapped, theme-aware aliases. Use these in all component and page styles: `--color-bg`, `--color-text`, `--color-text-secondary`, `--color-accent`, `--color-accent-hover`, `--color-border`, `--color-error`, `--color-success`, `--color-warning`, and surface variants `--color-bg-panel`, `--color-bg-inset`. Spacing: `--space-xs` through `--space-4xl`; gap aliases: `--gap-xs` through `--gap-xl` (point at `--space-*`).
3. **Component** (Tier 3) — per-component override points: `--nav-*` (incl. `--nav-height`, `--nav-overlay-bg`), `--footer-*`, `--btn-*`, `--card-*`, `--input-*`, `--badge-*`, `--accordion-*`, `--table-*`, `--code-*`, `--link-*`, `--quote-*`, `--pagination-*`, `--tooltip-*`, `--overlap-*`, `--wave-height`, `--arc-height`, `--blob-*`, `--diagonal-angle`. Override on `:root` for global rebrand or scope to any selector.

## FOWT prevention snippet

```html
<script>
  (function () {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('farn-theme');
    const system = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', stored ?? system);
  })();
</script>
```

## Sample system prompt

```
This project uses the Farn design system.
- Use semantic tokens (--color-*, --space-*, --text-*), never palette tokens (--in*, --bm*, --fo*, --bl*)
- Every Fraunces heading: font-variation-settings: 'opsz' <value>
- data-theme="dark|light" on <html>, data-surface="base|layer|overlay" on elements
Full reference: https://farn.jbpt.de/llms.txt
```

- [Motion](https://farn.jbpt.de/styles/motion) — duration + easing token reference
- [Components › Actions](https://farn.jbpt.de/components/actions) — buttons (`.btn`, `.btn-p`, `.btn-s`, `.btn-g`, `.btn-d`) + links
- [Components › Layout](https://farn.jbpt.de/components/layout) — cards, section transitions, quotes, separators, footer
- [Components › Navigation](https://farn.jbpt.de/components/navigation) — nav, breadcrumbs, accordion, pagination, tabs
- [Components › Forms](https://farn.jbpt.de/components/forms) — inputs, textarea, select, labels, error states
- [Components › Data](https://farn.jbpt.de/components/data) — badges (7 variants), tables, code blocks, tooltips
- [Components › Status](https://farn.jbpt.de/components/status) — spinner, skeleton loader
